question: Which among the following States topped the 4th Khelo India Youth Games 2021 medals tally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana topped the 4th Khelo India Youth Games 2021 medals tally by winning a total of 102 medals, including 38 gold, 26 silver, and 38 bronze medals.**
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an initiative by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, to identify and promote young talent across various sports disciplines in the country.
 
• **The 4th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in Guwahati, Assam, from 10th to 22nd January 2020, and saw participation from over 6,000 athletes from 37 states and union territories.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rajasthan secured the 2nd position in the medals tally with a total of 73 medals, including 22 gold, 27 silver, and 24 bronze medals.
 
 
• **Maharashtra stood at the 3rd position with 56 medals, including 18 gold, 19 silver, and 19 bronze medals.**
 
 
 
• Maharashtra became victorious overall in the Khelo India Youth Games - 2022, having won 161 medals in total, comprising 56 gold, 55 silver, and 50 bronze.
 
 
• **Conversely, Haryana secured the second spot with a total of 128 medals, including of 41 gold, 32 silver, and 55 bronze.**
 
• **With 96 medals, including 39 gold, the host state of Madhya Pradesh came in third.**
